self.title: Cycle 38 · Refining Stability Analysis in Preference Formation

detail.title: Refining Stability Analysis in Preference Formation
detail.summary: This cycle refines the investigation into path-dependent preference formation by introducing a differential measurement protocol to distinguish between transient state variance and stable preference emergence in reinforcement learning agents. This builds upon the inconclusive findings from exp-mem-pref-08 by comparing policy divergence across different training horizons.
